actors.name: Lucia Ferreyra
actors.private_context: Lucia is the co-director of a two-person nonprofit. She knows the Alder Foundation application is due by 17:00 on the 30th. The budget spreadsheet is the only unfinished piece. She knows their fiscal sponsor needs 48 hours to countersign before submission. She is aware that her co-director drafted most sections last month. She wants to submit the application on time.

actors.name: Co-director
actors.private_context: The co-director drafted most sections of the application last month. They know the budget spreadsheet is unfinished and that the fiscal sponsor needs 48 hours to countersign. They are aware of the deadline.

shared_context: The nonprofit has a fiscal sponsor that requires 48 hours to countersign the application before submission. The Alder Foundation application portal closes at 17:00 on the 30th. The budget spreadsheet is the only unfinished piece of the application. The co-director drafted most sections last month.

starting_events.description: Lucia and her co-director are aware of the upcoming deadline and the need to complete the budget spreadsheet and obtain the fiscal sponsor's countersignature.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the completed application was submitted to the Alder Foundation portal before 17:00 on the 30th. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
